name: woa-navigation-refactor
description: Refactor existing WOA views that violate the new single-main-window Navigation rule — feature views opened as sheets, popovers, or separate windows must instead load inline in the main view, with persistent Home / Back / related-view links.
---

<!-- Rename this file with the next sequence number in your existing
     .github/prompts/ convention, e.g. 02_woa-navigation-refactor.prompt.md -->

## Why this prompt exists

`copilot-instructions.md` now defines a **Navigation** rule (single main
window; no `.sheet`, `.popover`, `WindowGroup`, `openWindow`, or per-feature
`NSWindowController` for feature views; every view reachable via Home, Back,
and related-view links from the main view). That rule postdates earlier
scaffolding and feature prompts, so existing code was written before it
existed. This prompt's only job is to bring already-generated views into
compliance — it is a remediation pass, not a new feature.

This prompt inherits `AGENTS.md` and `copilot-instructions.md` automatically;
do not restate those rules here, only apply them.

## Step 1 — Inventory before changing anything

Scan `src/` and produce a list of every instance of:

- `.sheet(isPresented:` / `.sheet(item:`
- `.popover(isPresented:` / `.popover(item:`
- `WindowGroup` declared per feature (i.e. anything beyond the single
  app-level main window)
- `openWindow(id:` / `openWindow(value:`
- `NSWindowController` subclasses instantiated to host a feature view

For each match, classify it as:

- **Feature view presented as a popup/window** — in scope for this refactor.
- **Legitimate transient use** (confirmation dialog, alert, single-field
  quick edit, `NSOpenPanel`/`NSSavePanel` file picker) — out of scope, leave
  as-is per the Navigation rule's own exception.

Present this inventory as a table (file, view name, presentation type,
in/out of scope) before making changes.

## Step 2 — Refactor in-scope views

For each in-scope view:

- Remove the sheet/popover/window presentation wrapper.
- Wire the view into the main view's navigation structure so it loads in
  the content/detail pane (`NavigationSplitView` or `NavigationStack`),
  driven by selection/navigation state in the relevant ViewModel — not by
  a `@State` boolean tied to presentation.
- Do not change the view's internal presentation logic, its ViewModel's
  business logic, or any Service/Repository/Storage code — this is a
  navigation-wiring change only. Preserve existing functionality exactly.
- If the view was pushed data via a sheet's `item:` binding, replace that
  with a navigation-path or selection-based mechanism that carries the
  same data to the detail pane.

## Step 3 — Ensure main-view navigation chrome

Confirm (and add if missing) that the main view provides, visible from
every loaded feature view:

- A **Home** link that returns to the main landing view.
- A **Back / previous view** link returning to whatever view the user
  navigated from.
- Links to **related/key views** relevant to the current view's context
  (e.g. from a patient detail view, links to that patient's treatment
  plans or appointments).

Keep this chrome in one shared location (sidebar or toolbar) owned by the
main view — do not duplicate Home/Back logic inside each feature view.

## Constraints

- Preserve existing functionality; this is a structural/navigation
  refactor, not a rewrite of business logic.
- Do not touch Services, Repositories, or Storage layers.
- Update `src/WOA.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj` for any new or removed files,
  per `copilot-instructions.md`.
- No `TODO` placeholders; complete code only.

## Output Contract

- The Step 1 inventory table.
- Complete, refactored code for every in-scope view and any shared
  navigation container/ViewModel changes required to support it.
- A plan file at `.github/plans/<this-file-name>.plan.md` documenting what
  was found and how each view was migrated, per the existing Plan Files
  convention.
- Updated `project.pbxproj` entries for any file changes.

## Final Validation Checklist (Required in Output)

- No feature view remaining behind `.sheet`, `.popover`, a per-feature
  `WindowGroup`, `openWindow`, or `NSWindowController`
- Every migrated view reachable inline from the main view's navigation
  structure
- Home link present and functional from every view
- Back / previous-view link present and functional from every view
- Related/key-view links present where the original design implied them
- No regression in existing feature functionality
- No unresolved TODO placeholders
